study.question: Observed: localized_repeat AUC .6214080113 versus independent_repeat .6212760584, unlabeled_repeat .6206605632 and zero_repeat .6206038946 at one seed. Most of the gain over zero survives product replacement, so conditional repetition dependence is not yet established. Does preserving WHICH labeled action-age contexts share category-brand identities improve on summaries of repetition WITHIN each context, with the same visible events? The current source keeps context masses, conditional entropy/collision and pooled marginals, but omits individual cross-context collision entries.
study.hypothesis: For group g and contexts y!=z, K_g(y,z)=sum_x p_g(x|y)p_g(x|z) exposes where coarse category-brand bucket identities recur across contexts. The parent exposes diagonals and aggregate weighted sums, not their labeled off-diagonal allocation. A small appended residual may exploit that information; its utility is unknown. This is an empirical histogram Gram statistic, not a new mathematical primitive, an item-identity model or a temporal/causal transition estimator.

nearest_work.difference: DIN motivates candidate-conditioned aggregation and pooling information loss. Here fixed target-match groups and unlearned distribution-overlap features supplement the current local model; no claim of reproducing DIN or priority over its full literature.
Only field availability is verified: history supplies category, brand and behavior type, not items. Full DMR paper remains unavailable, so detailed architecture/novelty comparison is unresolved.

Retain the entire parent; add off-diagonal cross-context identity collision probabilities. Parent conditional entropy/collision distinguishes within-cell diversity but omits which cells share identities. Novelty against broader graph/histogram literature remains unverified; local mechanism difference only.

Organizer overview describes context transport, group exchange, token allocation, query generation and layerwise learned dot products in pCVR. This local contrast uses one fixed count-derived Gram summary; no source architecture transfer or source-level ablation claim.

inherited_components: all parent embeddings, mean pools in four true-match groups, count features, observed action-age histogram, independent learned moments and global norm-collapsed field readout
all existing joint identity, joint context and localized-repeat residuals and initializations
fixed 16 action-age contexts: action in pv/cart/fav/buy crossed with age <1h, 1h-1d, 1d-7d, >=7d; all four match groups; all fixed scales and missing-value rules
original host data/splits/scorer/seeds; no additional supervision, raw data access, optimizer or loss
study.proposed_difference: Append 480 off-diagonal identity-distribution overlap values (120 labeled context pairs per match group) to a new bias-free 480->16->1 residual, with final weight initially zero. Build sorted identity/group runs and a BxLx16 count table, then four 16x16 Grams; no vocabulary-sized or BxLxL training tensor. Compare observed values, occupied-pair product C_X(g), sorted unlabeled overlap multiset within each group, and zero. Parent conditional diagonal statistics remain unchanged in all cells. Missing contexts yield exact zero. Parent information-collision witness planned before execution: 4 identities each appearing twice in 4 contexts of mass two; disjoint 2x2 blocks versus a four-cycle keep all parent symbolic features equal but change cross-context overlap. Predictive and Torch correctness claims remain unmeasured.
predictions: Observed overlap should outperform product AND zero if the off-diagonal association adds predictive information; a win over zero alone is insufficient mechanism evidence. Report full-population ROC-AUC, Logloss, host slices and all costs.

If labels of the shared contexts matter, observed should outperform the unlabeled multiset; otherwise a multiset gain supports overlap shape only. Context permutation should preserve unlabeled features and change at least some labeled features.

Synthetic block/cycle histories should have equal complete parent features and conditional diagonals for arbitrary embeddings, but max observed off-diagonal gap .25 and product gap zero. This establishes a representation collision only, not predictive relevance. A second equal-parent witness only relabels disjoint blocks: labeled overlap gap .5, unlabeled and product gaps zero. The host diagnostics check all three histories.

Host diagnostics: run/scatter Gram agrees with independent dense equality oracle; diagonals recover parent conditional collisions; weighted total recovers global identity collision and trace recovers joint identity-context collision within 1e-5. Empty, zero-length, all-missing pairs, masked garbage padding and bijective bucket renaming must behave correctly.
falsifiers: Source or host failure of the information boundary, count invariants, dense oracle, witness parent equality, finite logits or finite gradients invalidates this implementation before scientific interpretation; retain costs and failure receipts.

Observed <= product or zero across paired repetitions weakens utility of the proposed information at this resolution and capacity. One failed implementation is not a refutation of all cross-context modeling.
Observed advantage over zero that product matches attributes benefit to redundant summary/readout capacity or optimization, not empirical overlap.
Unlabeled matches observed: no support for context-label localization. No useful support outside long histories: constrain the scope accordingly.
Measured cost exceeds the per-trial cap or a useful quality-cost frontier: do not assert efficiency from operation counts. No broader novelty claim without a wider primary-source review.
